Tonight would be too late. The free change window closes 2 hours after you ordered, so you have about 1 hour 40 minutes left. After that, the order is in the packing queue and can't be changed online. Support can try to intercept it before it ships, but that isn't guaranteed. If you want the pot on this order, I'd add it before the window closes.

I also need to correct my earlier message: the "don't repot for 2-3 weeks" care card advice isn't in my policy information, so please disregard it.
